name: Medixio
description: An AI agent that holds the care timeline for someone living with a chronic illness: appointments, medications, follow-ups. The LLM reads; typed, deterministic tools write. It never gives medical advice, and nothing consequential happens without a human confirming it.
signal: In progress: rebuilding from scratch after outgrowing v1

name: Perfect Binding
description: Turns a PDF into a print-ready booklet. Page imposition for saddle stitch, folded-and-glued, and perfect binding; pixel-level margin detection so the text prints larger; a sheet-by-sheet proof before you spend paper.
signal: Shipping: offline by construction, unit-tested pure-logic core

name: workout-pal
description: Describe how you train and an LLM returns a structured split. Then the app runs it one-handed, mid-set: a single-tap timer cycling ready → work → rest → overtime, per-set logging, session resume. The AI generates structure; deterministic code owns execution.
signal: Shipping: zero server-side persistence, Zod-validated LLM output

name: Learn Vim btw
description: Thirteen levels, from modes to marks. Each pairs one concept with a real in-browser Vim editor, so you practice motions, operators, and macros instead of reading about them.

name: Portfolio Site
description: This site. Static by default: one hydrated island for the mobile nav, everything else ships as HTML. Typed content collections, scoped styles over a token layer, lint gates on every commit.
